question: Why must all views enter like rivers the ocean?
premises: Therein all those views, like great rivers in the ocean, necessarily enter.
Unentered, they do not reach fulfillment.
inference: All views must dissolve ocean-wise, for unentered they stay unfulfilled.
plain_english: Therein all those views, like great rivers in the ocean, necessarily enter; unentered, they do not reach fulfillment.
